summary_en: K891, a subsidiary of Hikari Tsushin as of announcement date, launched a tender offer for all ordinary shares and subscription rights of Leo Palace21 (TSE Prime, code 8848) on September 14, 2026. Following the transaction, K891's parent K892 will receive capital contributions from MBK Partners-affiliated investment fund and NEC Capital Solutions' subsidiary OHANA PANA fund, converting K891 from a subsidiary to an affiliated company of Hikari Tsushin by settlement date.
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for Shares of Leo Palace21 by K891 (a Subsidiary at Time of Announcement) and Change in Subsidiary Status (to Affiliated Company)
translation_en_brief: On September 14, 2026, K891, a subsidiary of Hikari Tsushin, announced the commencement of a tender offer to acquire all ordinary shares and subscription rights of Leo Palace21 (Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime, code 8848). The offer will be conducted under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act. At the time of announcement, K891 is a direct subsidiary of Hikari Tsushin; however, K891's parent company K892 is scheduled to receive capital contributions from an investment fund operated by MBK Partners and an investment fund operated by OHANA PANA, a wholly owned subsidiary of NEC Capital Solutions. As a result of these capital contributions, which are conditional upon successful completion of the tender offer, K891 is expected to cease being a subsidiary of Hikari Tsushin and will instead become an affiliated company by the settlement date of the transaction. Hikari Tsushin expects the transaction to have immaterial impact on its consolidated business results for the fiscal year ending March 2027.
